0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5) come into this road game in 13th place in the East, 4 games back in the Central, on a four-game losing streak, while the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1) sit first in the Atlantic and the East and have won three straight. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Dailyn Swain, Jalen Smith and Tobe Awaka are day-to-day with back soreness, a finger sprain and an ankle sprain, all three listed as game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Joel Embiid (foot) is a game-time decision and LeBron James is listed as day-to-day. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1, though they lost the most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
